documents.text: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. Subscription fees are refunded in full if the plan was not used. Partial refunds apply when a billing period is more than half over.
documents.title: Refunds policy

documents.text: To reset a forgotten password, open the sign in page and choose Forgot password. We email a reset link that stays valid for 60 minutes. If the email does not arrive, check the spam folder or request a new link. Accounts with two factor authentication also confirm the reset in the authenticator app.
documents.title: Reset your password

documents.text: Invoices live under Settings, then Billing, then Invoice history. Each invoice can be downloaded as a PDF and includes the company name, tax identifier and the payment method used. To change the billing details printed on future invoices, edit the billing profile before the next charge date.
documents.title: Download an invoice

documents.text: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per API key. When the limit is exceeded the API returns status 429 with a Retry-After header. Batch endpoints count as one request per batch. Contact support to raise limits for production workloads with a steady high volume.
documents.title: API rate limits

documents.text: Workspace owners can export all workspace data from Settings, then Privacy, then Export. The export is prepared as a zip archive and a download link is emailed when it is ready, usually within one hour. Exports include documents, comments and file metadata, and the link expires after 7 days.
documents.title: Export your data
